messages:
Ravi (CS): Heads-up — MicaTech wants to renew but with tweaks: +8 seats, shorten to 9 months, and split payment: EU PO for EU seats, US CC for rest. Asking whether we can do a single SOW with two invoice targets.

Tessa (AE): Curious — do they want a blended price or keep region pricing separate? Also asked for a 5% concession because of the shorter term.

Ravi (CS): They requested blended price (same unit rate) but want invoice routing separated. CFO is paul.cfo@micatech.eu.

Priya (Finance): We can invoice two entities on one SOW, but need both billing headers + VAT for EU. Vendor code for EU is separate. PO + VAT up front speeds things.

Marta (Legal): We prefer separate billing exhibits appended to the same amendment. I can draft language to clarify payment obligations per billing entity and include sign blocks for both. Any special tax holdback notes?

Ravi (CS): Customer says no withholdings; EU will provide VAT and PO number. They'll sign electronically.

Tessa (AE): Two quick asks: 1) Confirm 5% concession applies only to seats on the 9mo short term. 2) Do we give 2 hours onboarding credit for the 8 new seats? MicaTech expects enablement.

Priya (Finance): Concession on EU vs US seats needs to be identical in ledger; we can show a line-item discount per seat. Onboarding credit can be invoiced as a $0 line item or credit memo — finance can handle.

Marta (Legal): I'll prepare a 1-pager amendment: 9mo term, +8 seats effective at renewal, line-item discount 5% on seats, billing exhibit A (PhotonEU PO details), billing exhibit B (US CC). Signatures: authorized rep for each entity. Draft by EOD.

Ravi (CS): Copying the PO stub they sent:```
PO#: TBD-ET-331
BillTo: MicaTech EU
VAT: EU123456789
Contact: paul.cfo@micatech.eu
NetTerms: Net30
```

OnboardingBot: New onboarding slot available: Tue 10am PT (2 slots). Claim with /book-onboard.

Tessa (AE): I'll ask them to confirm which seats are for EU vs US and push for PO number now. If legal shares amendment today I can get the EU signer to sign tomorrow morning.

Priya (Finance): Vendor-code turnaround for EU once we have PO# + VAT is ~48h. If they can submit PO today we expedite.

Marta (Legal): Drafting amendment now. Will include explicit invoicing instructions and fallback if PO fails (bill US entity).

Ravi (CS): Action list: Tessa -> confirm seat split + push for PO#; Priya -> prepare vendor-code workflow; Marta -> amendment draft EOD; Ravi -> schedule onboarding once seats confirmed.

Tessa (AE): Aiming to get PO# and signer availability by close of day. :calendar:

Ravi (CS): Thanks team. I'll follow up in the morning if anything stalls.
